parole.significato: An article of clothing that covers the part of the body between the waist and the ankles or knees, and is divided into…
parole.testo: Attested since the 1610s, from the earlier form trouzes (attested since the 1580s), extended from trouse (1570s), with plural ending typical of things in pairs, from Middle Irish triubus (“close-fitting shorts”), from Old Irish tribus, of uncertain origin. The unexplained intrusive second -r- is per
